```{r setup-payload}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(kableExtra)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Where to read the payload from.
#   NULL (default) -> alongside this .qmd (resolved at render time)
#   or set an explicit directory matching where the analysis output was placed.
# (The analysis runs outside the manuscript tree, so copy the .rds next to this
#  file or point payload_dir at it.)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
payload_dir <- "_payloads/"

.pdir <- if (is.null(payload_dir)) {
  tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) getwd())
} else {
  payload_dir
}
P <- readRDS(file.path(.pdir, "gbsg_table2new_payload.rds"))

# ---- formatters -----------------------------------------------------------
# numeric est/lo/hi -> "1.95 (1.04, 3.67)"
fci <- function(e, l, u, d = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(e), "\u2014", sprintf("%.*f (%.*f, %.*f)", d, e, d, l, d, u))
}

# R-style cut string -> inline-math house form:
#   "er <= 0 & pgr <= 10" -> "$\{er \le 0\} \cap \{pgr \le 10\}$"
fmt_label <- function(s) {
  if (is.null(s) || length(s) != 1L || is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return("\u2014")
  opmap <- c("<=" = "\\le", ">=" = "\\ge", "<" = "<", ">" = ">", "==" = "=")
  fmt_cut <- function(p) {
    m <- regmatches(p, regexec("^(\\S+)\\s*(<=|>=|==|<|>)\\s*(\\S+)$", p))[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 4L) {
      sprintf("\\{%s %s %s\\}", m[2], opmap[[m[3]]], m[4])
    } else {
      paste0("\\{", trimws(p), "\\}")
    }
  }
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(s, "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  paste0("$", paste(vapply(parts, fmt_cut, character(1)), collapse = " \\cap "), "$")
}

# seconds -> readable duration
fmt_dur <- function(sec) {
  if (is.null(sec) || is.na(sec)) return("\u2014")
  if (sec < 1)  return(sprintf("%.2f seconds", sec))
  if (sec < 90) return(sprintf("about %.0f seconds", sec))
  sprintf("about %.1f minutes", sec / 60)
}

# ---- precomputed prose fragments (keeps inline-R minimal) -----------------
fs_l    <- fmt_label(P$labels$fs)
grf_l   <- fmt_label(P$labels$grf)
dina_l  <- fmt_label(P$labels$dina)
same_fg <- identical(P$labels$fs, P$labels$grf)

h_desc <- if (same_fg) {
  paste0(fs_l, " for FS and GRF")
} else {
  paste0(fs_l, " for FS, ", grf_l, " for GRF")
}

cap_tbl <- paste0(
  "De-biased subgroup hazard ratios for the GBSG trial;",
  " parenthetical values are 95% confidence intervals. Here ",
  "$\\widehat{H}$ is ", h_desc, ", and ", dina_l, " for DINA.")

cf_sentence <- if (same_fg) {
  paste0("The GRF identifier selected the same ", fs_l,
         " subgroup as the FS identifier; DINA selected a distinct subgroup (",
         dina_l, ").")
} else {
  paste0("The GRF identifier selected ", grf_l, " and the FS identifier ", fs_l,
         "; DINA selected ", dina_l, ".")
}

ds <- P$labels$dina_standalone
dina_standalone_sentence <- if (isTRUE(ds$found)) {
  paste0("the DINA (\u00a77.2.2) identifier selects ", fmt_label(ds$label),
         " (N = ", ds$n, ") on the DINA scale without a Cox HR")
} else {
  "the DINA identifier (\u00a77.2.2) selected no subgroup on the DINA scale"
}

B_txt     <- format(P$meta$B, big.mark = ",")
# Multiplier-resampling draw count.  Prefer meta$mr_draws; fall back to the
# older meta$gate_draws for payloads written before the gate -> MR rename.
.draws    <- if (!is.null(P$meta$mr_draws)) P$meta$mr_draws else P$meta$gate_draws
draws_txt <- if (length(.draws) && !is.na(.draws)) format(.draws, big.mark = ",") else "\u2014"
# Cores ACTUALLY USED for the parallel sections, read from the analysis
# machine's payload.  Prefer machine$cores_used (the worker count); fall back
# to the older meta$cores = availableCores() for payloads written before the
# machine block existed.
.mi <- P$meta$machine
.cores_used <- if (!is.null(.mi) && length(.mi$cores_used) && isTRUE(is.finite(.mi$cores_used))) {
  .mi$cores_used
} else if (length(P$meta$cores) && isTRUE(is.finite(P$meta$cores))) {
  P$meta$cores
} else NA_integer_
cores_txt <- if (!is.na(.cores_used)) as.character(.cores_used) else "many"

# Optional hardware detail (CPU model + BLAS backend) from the analysis
# machine, to make the timing claim attributable.  Degrades to just the worker
# count when the machine block is absent.
.cpu_bits <- character(0)
if (!is.null(.mi)) {
  if (length(.mi$cpu_model) && !is.na(.mi$cpu_model)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, .mi$cpu_model)
  if (length(.mi$blas) && !is.na(.mi$blas)) {
    if (grepl("Accelerate|vecLib", .mi$blas))                 .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "Accelerate BLAS")
    else if (grepl("openblas", .mi$blas, ignore.case = TRUE)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "OpenBLAS")
    else if (grepl("mkl",      .mi$blas, ignore.case = TRUE)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "MKL")
  }
}
cores_phrase <- if (!is.na(.cores_used) && length(.cpu_bits)) {
  sprintf("%d worker%s (%s)", .cores_used, if (.cores_used == 1L) "" else "s", paste(.cpu_bits, collapse = ", "))
} else if (!is.na(.cores_used)) {
  sprintf("%d worker%s", .cores_used, if (.cores_used == 1L) "" else "s")
} else {
  "many cores"
}
# Timing across the three identifier analyses (FS, DINA, GRF): report the
# spread (fastest to slowest) rather than a single engine's time.
bs <- vapply(P$meta$timings, function(m) m$boot_sec, numeric(1)); bs <- bs[is.finite(bs)]
# MR timing.  Prefer timings$*$mr_sec; fall back to the older $gate_sec for
# payloads written before the gate -> MR rename.  A payload carrying neither
# yields NA, which the is.finite() filter drops -- the summary then degrades
# to an em-dash rather than erroring inside vapply().
.mr_sec <- function(m) {
  v <- if (!is.null(m$mr_sec)) m$mr_sec else m$gate_sec
  if (is.null(v) || !length(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v)[1]
}
mrs <- vapply(P$meta$timings, .mr_sec, numeric(1)); mrs <- mrs[is.finite(mrs)]
boot_min <- if (length(bs)) fmt_dur(min(bs)) else "\u2014"
boot_max <- if (length(bs)) fmt_dur(max(bs)) else "\u2014"
mr_min <- if (length(mrs)) fmt_dur(min(mrs)) else "\u2014"
mr_max <- if (length(mrs)) fmt_dur(max(mrs)) else "\u2014"
sp <- vapply(P$meta$timings, function(m) m$speedup, numeric(1)); sp <- sp[is.finite(sp)]
speedup_phrase <- if (length(sp)) {
  paste0("roughly ", format(round(min(sp)), big.mark = ","), " to ",
         format(round(max(sp)), big.mark = ","), " times faster")
} else {
  "far faster"
}
# --- scalar extractors for the prose (single source of truth = P$table) ---
.grow <- function(meth, reg) P$table[P$table$method == meth & P$table$region == reg, , drop = FALSE]
.gpt  <- function(df, col) if (nrow(df)==0L || is.na(df[[col]][1])) "\u2014" else sprintf("%.2f", df[[col]][1])
g_fs_fb   <- .gpt(.grow("FS","H"),   "fb_est")
g_fs_mr   <- .gpt(.grow("FS","H"),   "mr_est")
g_dina_mr <- .gpt(.grow("DINA","H"), "mr_est")
g_grf_mr  <- .gpt(.grow("GRF","H"),  "mr_est")

```

## German Breast Cancer Study Group (GBSG) tumor-recurrence analysis {#sec-application}

The GBSG trial (via the `survival` package [@survival-package]) records baseline age, menopausal status (meno), tumor size (size), a grade-3 indicator (grade3), positive lymph nodes (nodes), and progesterone (pgr) and estrogen (er) receptor concentrations; for pgr and er we use $J = 10$ cuts (@sec-family-construction). Forest search additionally admits pre-specified candidates — here `r fmt_label("er <= 0")` and `r fmt_label("pgr <= 0")`, evaluating receptor-defined subgroups directly (a feature we are not aware of in the current DINA and GRF algorithms).

The subgroups identified (full de-biased hazard-ratio table in the supplement) are: `r cf_sentence` Both FS corrections remain suggestive of harm (`r g_fs_fb` and `r g_fs_mr` under FB and MR) whereas for DINA and GRF only the MR corrections remain elevated (`r g_dina_mr` for DINA, `r g_grf_mr` for GRF). The two de-biasing routes differ sharply in cost: at $B =$ `r B_txt`, FB ran from `r boot_min` to `r boot_max` across the three identifiers and MR (`r draws_txt` draws) from `r mr_min` to `r mr_max` — `r speedup_phrase`, a margin that widens with $B$.
